description: Create, update (rename, change kind, pin a saved list to a plan list) or delete lists. A plan list's date goes in its name ("Sat, Oct 3 · Acadia"). Deleting a list moves its places to Unscheduled or to. Each op result has the list_id and kind of the list it used.

draft_handle.description: The draft_handle map_create returned; unsaved maps only.

expected_version.description: The version you planned this edit from. If someone else has since changed what it touches, nothing is applied and the result is a conflict with their changes and the current version.

kind.description: plan (default): part of the map's plan, numbered and routed in order: days, tours, houses, venues or neighborhoods to visit or compare. saved: places kept aside as options, only when the traveler asks to save, keep or collect them (favorites, maybes, ideas).
Convert to this kind; list_id stays.

pinned_to.description: Saved lists: the plan list it belongs to; null unpins.

to.description: An existing list for its places; default Unscheduled.

name: map_edit_lists
title: Edit lists
